description: Undergraduate data science student engineering the Lunar Site Navigator solo for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The project deterministically computes solar power and direct-to-Earth communication windows for lunar South Pole candidate landing sites by fusing NASA JPL Horizons API ephemeris scraping through the real-time data and building a complete web-based visualization tool keeping in mind the huge spectrum of users : comprising of learners, educators and mission planners, space researchers
